name: Large Bowl with Five Large Silver Splashes Against a Ground of Silver Oil Spots
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；12th-13th century；Northern black ware of Cizhou type: light gray stoneware with dark brown glaze, the markings in overglaze iron oxide. Probably from the kilns at Zibo, Shandong province.
